places.description: One of Europe's largest Baroque palaces, with magnificent halls, museums and extensive gardens.

places.description: Historic gardens around the palace with the popular fairy-tale garden and the autumn pumpkin exhibition.

places.name: Favorite Palace & Favoritepark
places.description: Baroque hunting lodge set in a vast wildlife park with free-roaming fallow deer.

places.name: Monrepos Lakeside Palace
places.description: Idyllic lakeside palace on the Eglosheimer See with park, boat rental and restaurant.

places.description: Baroque market square with arcades, two churches and a weekly market in the heart of the Baroque town.

places.name: Solitude Palace
places.description: Elegant Rococo palace above the hills of Stuttgart with a wonderful view.
